RECS.name: Minimal
RECS.effort: least setup that beats a single model
RECS.why: The cheapest real ensemble. A single streaming model runs ~2.4% WER; this cuts it to 1.38% using 2 paid key(s) plus free local medASR.

RECS.name: Recommended
RECS.effort: best value for a little more setup
RECS.why: Adds one more credential for 1.38% — the sweet spot between setup effort and accuracy.

RECS.name: Best value
RECS.effort: most accuracy per dollar spent
RECS.why: 1.5% for $0.69 per hour of DICTATED AUDIO (not shift time) — within 0.19pp of the outright best at $1.70/h less. Cost counts only the audio you actually dictate, so it scales with your volume, not your shift length.

RECS.name: Best
RECS.effort: lowest WER regardless of setup effort
RECS.why: The lowest-WER stack in the whole sweep (1.31%), including engines that need cloud service-account setup. Costs $2.39 per hour of dictated audio.
